programs.title: Tournament of Champions
programs.desc: Guy Fieri welcomes the four remaining culinary giants for two semifinal battles; the final head-to-head championship battle to win $150,000 will be judged by the three TOC champions and one genuine icon.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: The competition's first $20,000 prize winner is back to take on Michelle Wallace and Adam Greenberg in Guy Fieri's over-the-top challenge; judges Jet Tila and Jonathon Sawyer are on hand to taste the most bodacious dishes in Flavortown history.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Say cheese! The reigning champion defends their title against chefs Jamie Tran and Isaac Toups as they prove to judges Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso that they can handle the cheesy curveballs and dairy-driven twists of Guy Fieri's Flavortown restaurants.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the competitors to leave the plates behind and serve everything in a bowl; the returning champion takes on chefs Martel Stone and Evelyn Garcia to win over judges Antonia Lofaso and Aaron May in Flavortown's fiercest competition yet.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Chefs take on a grocery list containing dish-clashing ingredients, but the chefs have to use every item on the list.
